mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies by the Verona Public Library with the moon in its first quarter. If you are up early, look for the ISS rising from the direction of Belleville toward Fitchburg and Madison for three minutes starting at 4:09 AM. We are looking at an overnight low of 59 degrees with no rain expected.

The city continues to manage the Mark Drive and surrounding street reconstruction project. Phase two is underway with utility work following the recent removal of old pavement and trees. Additionally, the city is committed to expanding our active transportation network by adding sidewalks to create safer, more connected neighborhoods.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and the Downtown Farmer's Market. Tomorrow, you can catch the Concerts in the Park series at Century School Park or join the trivia competition at Hop Haus Brewing.
In our weekly police update, officers reported that this past Friday, a 29-year-old local man was arrested for a second offence O W I after a report of a reckless driver was called in by a citizen.
Make sure to stop by Culver's to grab the Double Strawberry flavor of the day. They are open until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to satisfy that sweet tooth.
